AI Hub - macOS
==============

1. Unzip this folder somewhere you like (double-click the .zip), for example into Documents.

2. The first time, open Terminal, go to the folder and run the guided setup:
       cd ~/Documents/ai-hub
       ./bootstrap.sh
   It checks Node.js (version 18 or newer), offers to install what is missing
   with Homebrew (it always asks first), then runs the guided setup.

3. From then on, double-click  start.command
   The interface opens in your browser. Close the Terminal window to stop it.
   Tip: "npm run shortcut" (in Terminal, inside this folder) puts a launcher on your desktop.

macOS may block downloaded scripts ("cannot be opened because it is from an unidentified
developer"). Either right-click the file -> Open -> Open, or remove the download flag once:
       xattr -dr com.apple.quarantine ~/Documents/ai-hub

Minimum: macOS 12 or newer (Apple Silicon or Intel), Node.js 18+ (installed for you via
Homebrew if missing), about 200 MB of free disk space, a modern web browser.
Optional: Git (installing skills from GitHub; macOS offers the Command Line Tools),
one AI tool (Claude Code, Codex, Antigravity CLI or OpenCode).

Docs: GUIDE.md.
